modalities.evidence: two large-scale electronic health record (EHR) databases

output.population: Patient records in MIMIC-III and eICU, two large-scale electronic health record databases
output.summary: Preprocessed features and labels derived from MIMIC-III and eICU-CRD records using the FIDDLE pipeline, covering five prediction tasks for in-hospital mortality, acute respiratory failure and shock, released for reproducible machine learning research.
